articles.title: Alliance Receives Credit Ratings Upgrade from S&P Global Ratings
articles.summary: RIPON, Wis., September 02, 2026--Alliance Laundry Holdings Inc. (NYSE: ALH) ("Alliance" or the "Company"), the world’s premier provider of commercial laundry systems, today announced that S&P Global Ratings ("S&P") has upgraded the Company’s issuer credit rating to ‘BB-’ from ‘B+’. Concurrently, S&P upgraded its issue-level rating on Alliance’s senior secured first lien credit facilities to ‘BB’ from ‘BB-’, with a recovery rating of ‘2’. S&P assigned a positive outlook to the ratings.
